name: Sling Pop
shortDescription: Slingshot a jelly onto a scrolling wall of colored blocks. Land where colors touch to pop the group, rocket higher, and chain combos — before the ever-faster scroll drags you under.

suggestion.prompt:
## App Suggestion

**Category:** Games
**Requestor:** Jeff H.

### Description

Create a game lending Tetris, Dr. Mario, Angry Birds, and endless jump-scrollers into 1 addictive loop. Player drags-and-releases to slingshot-launch a character upward (Angry Birds aiming) onto a grid of colored platform blocks. Landing on a block that matches an adjacent color clears them (Dr. Mario style), granting points + a height boost. Platforms scroll downward continuously, increasing pressure (jump-scroller tension) and difficulty over time. Combos multiply score. Falling off-screen or getting pinned at the bottom ends the run. One-handed drag controls only, 5-second learning curve, instant restart, juicy feedback (squash/stretch, particles, screen shake, Web Audio SFX). Single self-contained HTML file, canvas rendering, responsive to any mobile screen, touch+mouse support, 60fps, localStorage high score, simple start/game-over screens. Prioritize replayability and game feel over features. Build...

generation.notes: Built from approved issue #604. Selection script flagged duplicationRisk high (43) but all matches were generic keywords (game/canvas/touch); no existing app uses slingshot aiming or match-on-landing, so the concept was judged meaningfully distinct. Design: the aim IS the color-match decision — landing on a block touching same-color neighbors flood-fill pops the group, scores 10 x size x combo, and auto-boosts the player upward for chains; non-matching landings perch and reset the combo. Assumptions: platforms are one-way (land from above, pass through from below) for fair aiming; side walls bounce the player (bank shots) to keep one-handed play forgiving; 8% of blocks are neutral stone that never pops, creating safe perches and aim constraints. Squash/stretch, particles, screen shake, and synthesized Web Audio SFX per the juicy-feedback requirement. localStorage high score plus shared leaderboard. All vanilla JS/canvas, no assets.
